query:
UPDATE ingredient
        SET
            name          = COALESCE($1, name),
            active        = COALESCE($2, active),
            cost_per_unit = CASE WHEN $4 THEN $3::float8::numeric ELSE cost_per_unit END
        WHERE id = $5
        RETURNING
            id                       AS "id!: Uuid",
            name                     AS "name!",
            active                   AS "active!",
            cost_per_unit::float8    AS "cost_per_unit?: f64"
